prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’ve heard from a reliable source that the council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left out even a minute past 8am. They are finally using their ridiculous power to turn our neighborhood into a police state over trash."
text: The council is officially launching a neighborhood-wide surveillance operation and will be slapping us with massive, crippling fines for any bins left out at all. They’re effectively turning our streets into a total police state over our trash.
